description: This file contains utility functions for Mesh Agent operations, including syscfg and sysevent interactions, service management, network interface handling, and LED control, primarily for embedded or network device firmware.

methods.name: Mesh_SyseventGetStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from sys event by name.

methods.name: Mesh_SyseventSetStr
methods.description: Sets a string value in sys event by name, optionally sending to ARM.

methods.name: Mesh_SysCfgGetInt
methods.description: Gets an integer configuration value from syscfg.

methods.name: Mesh_SysCfgSetInt
methods.description: Sets an integer configuration value in syscfg.

methods.name: Mesh_SysCfgGetStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string configuration value from syscfg.

methods.name: Mesh_SysCfgSetStr
methods.description: Sets a string configuration value in syscfg, optionally sending to ARM.

methods.name: svcagt_get_service_state
methods.description: Checks if a system service is active.

methods.name: svcagt_set_service_state
methods.description: Starts or stops a system service.

methods.name: svcagt_set_service_restart
methods.description: Restarts a system service.

methods.name: ping_ip
methods.description: Pings an IP address to check connectivity.

methods.name: nif_ioctl
methods.description: Performs an ioctl system call on network interface.

methods.name: nif_ifreq
methods.description: Performs an ioctl request on a network interface.

methods.name: nif_exists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface exists.

methods.name: nif_ipaddr_get
methods.description: Retrieves IP address of a network interface.

methods.name: nif_netmask_get
methods.description: Retrieves netmask of a network interface.

methods.name: get_ipaddr_subnet
methods.description: Calculates subnet information for a network interface.

methods.name: udhcpc_pid
methods.description: Gets the DHCP client process ID for an interface.

methods.name: udhcpc_start
methods.description: Starts DHCP client on an interface.

methods.name: udhcpc_stop
methods.description: Stops DHCP client on an interface.

methods.name: handle_uplink_bridge
methods.description: Configures or removes uplink bridge network setup.

methods.name: led_state
methods.description: Controls LED animation and color.

methods.name: handle_led_status
methods.description: Updates LED status based on mesh connection state.

methods.name: is_eth_connected
methods.description: Returns Ethernet connection status.
